canonical.name: Ordinary character theory on this page stays over $\mathbb C$ for finite $G$ and finite-dimensional representations only
The class-function inner product follows the library's linear-first convention from the published inner-product page

The count of irreducibles versus conjugacy classes is imported from the published RT-2 page, while this page still proves row orthogonality, column orthogonality, and the regular-character second proof of the sum-of-squares formula
